h1: What Are Homophonic Puns? Meaning & Examples
meta_title: Homophonic Puns: Meaning, How They Work & Examples
meta_description: Homophonic puns use words that sound alike but mean different things. See how they work, why they land and examples you can use.

h1: What Are Homographic Puns? Meaning & Examples
meta_description: Homographic puns play on words spelled the same but with different meanings. Learn how they work with simple, funny examples.

meta_description: Homonymic puns use words that sound and look the same but mean different things. Learn how they differ from other pun types, with examples.
